name: London
scene: Tower Bridge over the Thames, a red double-decker bus with no writing or route number, a black cab and Georgian terraces
palette: navy, river teal, muted stone, red and warm cream

name: Tokyo
scene: Shibuya-style crossing and abstract unlettered neon lights, red-and-white Tokyo Tower within a balanced skyline, cherry blossom and a bullet train with no markings
palette: navy, petrol teal, coral red, pale blossom pink and warm cream

name: Bangkok
scene: Wat Arun-like temple spires along the river, long-tail boats, an unmarked tuk-tuk and a floating market
palette: deep teal, navy, gold, terracotta coral and sage green

name: Rome
scene: the Colosseum within a layered low cityscape, umbrella pines, terracotta roofs, an unbranded vintage Italian scooter and a stone fountain
palette: navy, warm cream stone, terracotta coral, sage and muted gold

name: Barcelona
scene: original Gaudí-inspired mosaic curves and imaginative stone spires, no exact copy of Sagrada Família; a beach, palms and warm stone buildings
palette: deep teal, navy, mosaic coral and gold, sage and warm stone cream

name: Dubai
scene: a balanced needle-like tower skyline, desert dunes at its edge, a wooden dhow on the creek and a sail-shaped hotel silhouette within the skyline
palette: navy, creek teal, sand cream, muted gold and coral

name: Istanbul
scene: domes and slender minarets above the Bosphorus, a ferry, gulls, a bridge at sunset and the saffron/coral colours of a spice market
palette: navy, teal, warm stone cream, saffron gold, coral and sage

name: Amsterdam
scene: gabled canal houses, bicycles on a little arched bridge, a canal boat and tulips
palette: navy, canal teal, brick coral, sage, mustard gold and warm cream

name: Hong Kong
scene: Victoria Harbour's balanced skyline, a red-sailed junk, a green-and-white harbour ferry and the Peak's green slopes
light: warm sunset giving way to early evening
palette: navy, harbour teal, red coral sails, sage hills and warm gold

name: Seoul
scene: a palace gate with curved tiled roofs, Namsan tower on its wooded hill, hanok rooftops and autumn maples
palette: navy, deep teal, maple coral, mustard gold, sage and warm ivory
